title: Fabrication of hydroxylated norbornene foams via frontal polymerization for catalytic applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,19264-19272
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01510C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Andrew Vogler, Tina Dinh, Hanlin M. Wang, Ghaida Aldhahri, Arfa Abrar Malik, Diego Alzate-Sanchez
Frontal polymerization of HMNB in the presence of blowing agents rapidly generates polymeric foams with low energy inputs. Functionalized with Pd nanoparticles, these foams serve as recyclable catalytic scaffolds.
